name: reasoning-steps
title: Reasoning Steps
description: A collapsible reasoning trace for AI replies: a shimmering trigger label with a self-timing readout, steps that pop from a dot into a check, nested details and source pills, and the active step announced to screen readers.
label: Iconiq by Edwin Vakayil
author: Edwin Vakayil <https://github.com/edwinvakayil>
attribution: Iconiq, Copyright (c) 2024-2026 Edwin Vakayil. MIT License.

props.name: ReasoningSteps duration
props.description: Elapsed reasoning time in seconds for the readout. Leave unset and the trigger times itself while any step is active.

props.name: ReasoningSteps open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled expanded state of the timeline.

props.name: ReasoningStepsTrigger children
props.description: The trigger label; it shimmers while a step is active. Collapsed, the active step's label slides in under it.

props.name: ReasoningStep status
props.description: Pending steps render nothing until they become active or done; an active step shows a dot that pops into a check once done.

props.name: ReasoningStep label / description / id
props.description: The step's line, an optional second line, and a stable identity (generated when omitted).

props.name: ReasoningStepDetails summary / defaultOpen
props.description: A nested disclosure inside a step for the longer explanation.

props.name: ReasoningStepSources, ReasoningStepSource href
props.description: Citation pills under a step; with href a pill is a link that opens in a new tab.

props.name: ReasoningStepImage src / alt / caption
props.description: A small figure inside a step.

a11y: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls (from the primitive); Enter and Space toggle the timeline, and the nested details work the same way.
A polite live region announces the active step's label as it changes, so screen-reader users hear the reasoning progress without opening the timeline (a Labs addition).
Source pills that link out say so to screen readers ("opens in a new tab"), and the step glyphs and connector lines are decorative.
React Aria: the collapsed panel is hidden with hidden="until-found", so find-in-page can still reveal a step.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the shimmer, pops and height animations are off: the panel opens and closes instantly.
usage:
<ReasoningSteps>
  <ReasoningStepsTrigger>Reasoning</ReasoningStepsTrigger>
  <ReasoningStepsContent>
    <ReasoningStep label="Reading the request" status="done" />
    <ReasoningStep label="Drafting the answer" status="active" />
  </ReasoningStepsContent>
</ReasoningSteps>
